bibl.title: The Anabolikon Tax and the Study of the Linen Industry in Roman Egypt.

bibl.note: Paper given at a conference held at New York University's Institute for the Study of the Ancient World (ISAW) on September 30 and October 1, 2016. The conference was entitled "The Mechanics of Extraction: Comparing Principles of Taxation and Tax Compliance in the Ancient World."
